🚨 WE NEED A ROCKSTAR SETTER 🚨

The Luxora Collective is growing fast and we are looking for an absolute GO-GETTER who LOVES:
📞 Cold calling
🤝 Networking
📅 Setting appointments
🔥 Starting conversations
💰 Chasing opportunity

This is NOT an “order taker” role.
We want someone hungry. Competitive. Persistent. Someone who gets excited hearing “no” because they know the next “yes” is coming.

We work in the medical aesthetics / med spa industry helping practice owners scale through high-ticket growth systems, retention strategies, memberships, revenue optimization, and client acquisition.

Here’s the comp structure:
💵 $29 per qualified appointment set
💵 PLUS $250 when that appointment closes

No capped commissions.
If you can produce, you can make REAL money here.

This can VERY easily grow into a high-ticket closer role inside our company for the right person. Right now though, we need a killer setter who can help us fill calendars and create opportunities.

We also have a super tight-knit team culture. We’re building a real ecosystem here, not just hiring random people to punch a clock. We want someone who wants to grow WITH us long term.

Aesthetics/med spa experience is a huge plus, but not required.
Sales confidence, grit, personality, and work ethic matter more.

If this sounds like you, DM me with:
• Your sales background
• Experience with cold outreach/calling
• Biggest wins
• Why you’d crush this role

Let’s build something huge together. 🔥
:::
